body.justification: The operational deliverable is an honest fixed-horizon confidence interval, not merely an oracle linear representation.
body.gap: Existing causal RMST Wald procedures require positive follow-up or high-level nuisance conditions and do not establish uniform coverage on the displayed quadratic-endpoint primitive class.
body.consumer: The result directly supports nominal confidence reporting for adjusted five-year RMST contrasts in CFsurvival-style analyses.
